verse.unicode: ਗਈ ਬਹੋੜੁ ਬੰਦੀ ਛੋੜੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਦੁਖਦਾਰੀ ॥

transliteration.english: giee bahoR ba(n)dhee chhoR nira(n)kaar dhukhadhaaree ||

en.bdb: The Restorer of what was taken away, the Liberator from captivity; the Formless Lord, the Destroyer of pain.

verse.unicode: ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥

transliteration.english: karam na jaanaa dharam na jaanaa lobhee maiaadhaaree ||

en.bdb: I do not know about karma and good deeds; I do not know about Dharma and righteous living. I am so greedy, chasing after Maya.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਗਤੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਇਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: naam pario bhagat govi(n)dh kaa ieh raakhahu paij tumaaree ||1||

en.bdb: I go by the name of God's devotee; please, save this honor of Yours. ||1||
O Dear Lord, You are the honor of the dishonored.

verse.unicode: ਨਿਚੀਜਿਆ ਚੀਜ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: nicheejiaa cheej kare meraa govi(n)dh teree kudharat kau kurabaan || rahaau ||

en.bdb: You make the unworthy ones worthy, O my Lord of the Universe; I am a sacrifice to Your almighty creative power. ||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਜੈਸਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਲਖ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥

transliteration.english: jaisaa baalak bhai subhaiee lakh aparaadh kamaavai ||

en.bdb: Like the child, innocently making thousands of mistakes

verse.unicode: ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਝਿੜਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥

transliteration.english: kar upadhes jhiRake bahu bhaatee bahuR pitaa gal laavai ||

en.bdb: his father teaches him, and scolds him so many times, but still, he hugs him close in his embrace.

verse.unicode: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: pichhale aaugun bakhas le prabh aagai maarag paavai ||2||

en.bdb: Please forgive my past actions, God, and place me on Your path for the future. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥

transliteration.english: har a(n)tarajaamee sabh bidh jaanai taa kis peh aakh sunaieeaai ||

en.bdb: The Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows all about my state of mind; so who else should I go to and speak to?

verse.unicode: ਕਹਣੈ ਕਥਨਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥

transliteration.english: kahanai kathan na bheejai gobi(n)dh har bhaavai paij rakhaieeaai ||

en.bdb: The Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is not pleased by mere recitation of words; if it is pleasing to His Will, He preserves our honor.

verse.unicode: ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਇਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਰਹਾਈਐ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: avar oT mai sagalee dhekhee ik teree oT rahaieeaai ||3||

en.bdb: I have seen all other shelters, but Yours alone remains for me. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥

transliteration.english: hoi dhiaal kirapaal prabh Thaakur aape sunai bena(n)tee ||

en.bdb: Becoming kind and compassionate, God the Lord and Master Himself listens to my prayer.

verse.unicode: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤੀ ॥

transliteration.english: pooraa satagur mel milaavai sabh chookai man kee chi(n)tee ||

en.bdb: He unites me in Union with the Perfect True Guru, and all the cares and anxieties of my mind are dispelled.

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੰਤੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੨॥

transliteration.english: har har naam avakhadh mukh paiaa jan naanak sukh vasa(n)tee ||4||12||62||

en.bdb: The Lord, Har, Har, has placed the medicine of the Naam into my mouth; servant Nanak abides in peace. ||4||12||62||
